title: Proper-face category and simplicial diagram
statement: Let $K:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ be a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] of any category $\mathcal C$. For $n\geq0$, let $\mathcal I_n$ be the full subcategory of $\Delta/[n]$ on injective order-preserving maps $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ with $k<n$. Its arrows from $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ to $\delta\prime:[k\prime]\to[n]$ are order-preserving $\varepsilon:[k]\to[k\prime]$ with $\delta\prime\varepsilon=\delta$. Define $P_n(K):\mathcal I_n^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ by $P_n(K)(\delta)=K_k$ and $P_n(K)(\varepsilon^{\mathrm{op}})=K(\varepsilon)$. For $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n+1$, the injection omitting $i$ defines the distinguished object $\delta_i$ of $\mathcal I_{n+1}$. In degree zero $\mathcal I_0$ is empty. No limit or matching-object comparison theorem is asserted.
